title: Auto-Interp Explanation Faithfulness Across Explainer Models

original_idea.body:
# Auto-Interp Explanation Faithfulness Across Explainer Models

**Problem:** The dependence of SAE auto-interp explanation faithfulness on which explainer LLM is used is rarely varied.

**Direction:** Generate auto-interp explanations for GPT-2-small SAE features using 2-3 open explainer models. Score each with standard simulation scoring. Compare faithfulness across explainers and cost.

**Why it matters:** Auto-interp is the scalable backbone of SAE monitoring; knowing whether cheap explainers suffice tells outside researchers if they can do credible interpretability.

**Relevant context:** EleutherAI sae-auto-interp; OpenAI neuron-explanation scoring.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: auto-interp reliability underpins SAE monitoring, but the link to catastrophic risk is indirect/methodological.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Run auto-interp pipeline with several explainers + simulation scoring; guided, some pipeline setup.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused comparison of explainers; depends on getting the auto-interp scoring pipeline working.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Tooling-budget question for outside researchers labs deprioritize; public SAEs.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference with small/larger explainers; moderate but feasible on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Auto-interp scoring exists; explainer-model sensitivity comparison may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Auto-interp scoring exists; explainer-model sensitivity comparison may be partly open.
